timing.reason: Freeze the interpretation and follow-up routing before the remaining eleven shards reveal the full failure pattern.

required_final_C7a_localization.paired_geometry: For every material compare 10 cm and 20 cm without changing samples, thresholds or candidate.
aggregate: number of failed classes by check
structural versus accuracy versus evidence-sufficiency failure counts

R1_STRUCTURAL_OR_REFERENCE_SEMANTICS_FAI.trigger: Any class fails provider construction/shape, finite candidate evaluation, zero-runtime-oracle semantics, sign preservation, or the independent reference oracle itself.
R1_STRUCTURAL_OR_REFERENCE_SEMANTICS_FAI.interpretation: Do not diagnose this as table density or classifier narrowness. First resolve representation/reference semantics or implementation correctness.
R1_STRUCTURAL_OR_REFERENCE_SEMANTICS_FAI.allowed_next: Separate correctness characterization with no production or transient admission.
R1_STRUCTURAL_OR_REFERENCE_SEMANTICS_FAI.forbidden_next: No geometry tuning, threshold relaxation or classifier widening to hide a structural failure.

R2_EVIDENCE_SUFFICIENCY_ONLY_FAILURE.trigger: One or more classes fail only because admitted_cases < 100 or active_admitted_cases < 60 while structural and evaluated accuracy checks otherwise pass.
R2_EVIDENCE_SUFFICIENCY_ONLY_FAILURE.interpretation: The frozen classifier does not provide enough demonstrated support for full catalog coverage in those classes.
R2_EVIDENCE_SUFFICIENCY_ONLY_FAILURE.allowed_next: Characterize why the frozen classifier excludes those classes. A narrower explicitly qualified production applicability domain is only a separate future hypothesis, with independent use-case justification and a fresh holdout.
R2_EVIDENCE_SUFFICIENCY_ONLY_FAILURE.forbidden_next: Do not widen the classifier or lower sample requirements using C7a rows.

R3_STRONG_GRADIENT_GEOMETRY_DEPENDENT_AC.trigger: Accuracy failures are concentrated in strong-gradient p90 while structural, evidence-sufficiency and near-saturation checks remain green, and paired 10/20 cm results show material-specific geometry dependence.
R3_STRONG_GRADIENT_GEOMETRY_DEPENDENT_AC.interpretation: Treat face geometry as an explicit representation variable. A global density increase is not automatically justified.
R3_STRONG_GRADIENT_GEOMETRY_DEPENDENT_AC.allowed_next: Characterization-only geometry sensitivity using already established physically relevant face lengths. Candidate coordinate/normalization changes must be materially new and precommitted before testing. Any promoted candidate then requires a new unseen holdout.
R3_STRONG_GRADIENT_GEOMETRY_DEPENDENT_AC.forbidden_next: Do not patch only the observed failing length or insert pair-specific tables.

R4_MATERIAL_TRANSITION_SCALE_ACCURACY_FA.trigger: Failures persist for the same material across both geometries or occur across several materials in a pattern not explained primarily by face length.
R4_MATERIAL_TRANSITION_SCALE_ACCURACY_FA.interpretation: Characterize whether fixed absolute-head anchors fail to resolve material-specific hydraulic transition scales.
R4_MATERIAL_TRANSITION_SCALE_ACCURACY_FA.allowed_next: Characterization-only comparison of materially new globally bounded coordinates such as hydraulic-scale-normalized head, effective saturation, or conductivity-based coordinates. Selection must occur before any new qualification holdout.
R4_MATERIAL_TRANSITION_SCALE_ACCURACY_FA.forbidden_next: Do not add material-specific hand-tuned knots after looking at failing rows.

R5_NEAR_SATURATION_OR_CONSTITUTIVE_OWNER.trigger: Failures are dominated by near-saturation behavior or align with the already-known inherited conductivity transition/discontinuity seam.
R5_NEAR_SATURATION_OR_CONSTITUTIVE_OWNER.interpretation: Route the constitutive issue to its owner boundary before claiming a numerical representation repair.
R5_NEAR_SATURATION_OR_CONSTITUTIVE_OWNER.allowed_next: Owner-level constitutive qualification, then rerun LayeredMFP evidence against the qualified constitutive contract.
R5_NEAR_SATURATION_OR_CONSTITUTIVE_OWNER.forbidden_next: Do not use interpolation density or classifier thresholds to mask an inherited constitutive discrepancy.

R6_WIDESPREAD_MULTI_CHECK_REPRESENTATION.trigger: Failures are broad across materials/geometries and span multiple accuracy checks, even though structural semantics remain correct.
R6_WIDESPREAD_MULTI_CHECK_REPRESENTATION.interpretation: Reject the frozen n49 endpoint-pair family for full catalog generalization rather than accumulating local exceptions.
R6_WIDESPREAD_MULTI_CHECK_REPRESENTATION.allowed_next: Open a materially new representation feasibility/characterization gate or stop this candidate family.
R6_WIDESPREAD_MULTI_CHECK_REPRESENTATION.forbidden_next: No patch ladder of material-specific exceptions, density escalation without new hypothesis, or production fallback disguised as numerical policy.

isolated_failure_policy.rule: Even if the completed map contains only one failing class, C7a remains NOT_QUALIFIED. An isolated failure may justify targeted characterization of sensitivity but not full-catalog production admission.

transient_boundary.reason: A transient gate must not be used to rescue a hydraulic face representation that already failed its full-catalog hydraulic qualification.
